visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Rebuilt top-to-bottom 2026-10-05 against the 2026-09-28 walk of 11 seller paths (/workspace/competitor-sell-paths-2026-09-28/SYNTHESIS.md). Section map: hero modeled on Redfin outcome headline + Stellar first-screen proof + Strategic face + Redfin/Opendoor address-as-CTA; how-we-sell on Compass phased clarity + Stellar numbered process; reviews on Stellar/Opendoor social proof; closings on Stellar client results with real MLS data; FAQ on Stellar answered Q&A; final ask on Redfin/Stellar close. Beat locals (no face+proof on fold, contact-first forms) and nationals (no local person). Zero invented results.
note: Rebuilt 2026-10-05 from Matt's feedback (hero must make sense in one read; whole page not just the fold) and the Phase 1 competitor walk. Rhythm: no two adjacent sections share a pattern. Cut: market sections, property-type rows, the blog/site link block, Expand ask, the 3% hero label, full reviewer names, the sticky ask. ?from=cma changes ONLY the hero copy, client-side over the static HTML, so /sell keeps revalidate 3600.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: JSON-LD BreadcrumbList + Service + FAQPage + WebPage. FAQPage items are the same SELL_FAQ_ITEMS array V3Quiet renders.

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Opens the page. headingLevel 1, height tall. H1 opens with the seo-shell head term (Sell your Central Oregon home with a local broker who prices it right). altEyebrow/altHeadline carry the ?from=cma copy (For homeowners whose listing ended / Your listing ended. Let's talk about what's next.), both in the static HTML. Poster is a pre-sized srcset of the Drake Park aerial, each file under 300 KB.

requiredComponents.name: SellValueForm
requiredComponents.section: The ONE primary action, inside SellCapture on the Stage: first-screen proof line (Google rating + count, homes sold) with its trace, Matt’s face (name, Principal Broker, license), the address field and the submit labelled Talk to us about your home, then a small call/text link. Same flow, action and payload as before; steps are address, market read, timing, contact (contact last, as the submit).

requiredComponents.name: SellHowWeSell
requiredComponents.section: How we sell in 3 steps (price from closed sales; complete launch in week one with photo, drone, video and 3D in the 3%; a written weekly report). Lead line under the heading. Full PLAN_GROUPS inclusions behind one native details toggle. Eyebrow is process, not the fee.

requiredComponents.name: V3ProofBlock
requiredComponents.section: Reviews through the existing switcher, reviewer INITIALS ONLY (withInitialsOnly). Outcome strips OFF (Matt 2026-09-08). No reach strip.

requiredComponents.name: SellClosings
requiredComponents.section: Up to 6 Ryan Realty list-side closings in the last 12 months from MLS closed data (getOfficeRecentClosings): city, beds, price, days to contract, sale to final list. Lead line under the heading. No street, month or names. Not links. Renders nothing with no rows.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Four selling questions (SELL_FAQ_ITEMS), heading 'Selling questions, answered'. The same array feeds FAQPage.

requiredComponents.name: SellFinalAsk
requiredComponents.section: The primary action repeated once (a link to the same value-flow field), heading 'Ready to talk about your home?', small call/text links, and the one link to the full Bend market report that replaces the market sections.

requiredComponents.name: SellClickTracker
requiredComponents.section: Tracking island: every link and CTA click on /sell to cta_click (visitor_events) + trackCtaClick (GA4 + CRM). Enforced by ci:sell-cta-tracking.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. No button. Rendered OUTSIDE main.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.note: Landed E-CHROME. Not remounted on this page.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale and would push the page to five patterns.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: Sold-story cards used to be a third proof rail. Rhythm allows as many patterns as the content needs; only the no-two-adjacent rule binds (the cap was killed 2026-08-27). Proof now lives as Instrument figures plus Quiet prose. A Ledger of sold homes would be a fifth pattern.

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator (Cursor Task). grok CLI, cursor-agent, and claude CLI were not installed in this sandbox, so the chain could not sign via taste-evaluate.ts. Builder is grok-4.6. Three scorings in one call (73 / 76 / 69). The route publishes no competitiveBrief.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, custom Playwright open-state capture against next dev --webpack -p 3111, scale 1, palette-quantized. default: page as served. address-focus: #get-value-address click framed on #get-value. ask-open: [data-taste=ask-open] click. address-error: type abc + submit, await .sell-field__error. address-ok: fill 61271 Kwinnum Dr, Bend, OR 97702, await [data-taste=address-confirm], data-sell-focus=pinned, and #sell-hero img.sell-stage-street complete. answer-open: type full street + submit, await .sell-answer (180s).

tasteReview.beats: Beats Zillow's What's my home worth estimator on data honesty and depth: Zillow returns a bare Zestimate with no citation, while this page's answer sheet sources a months-of-supply verdict and a days-to-pending scrubber to a named metric layer and shows the actual typed lot.

defects.finding: The Stage photograph swap uses Google Static Maps hybrid tiles with no style parameter, so the payoff for typing a real address is stock satellite chrome with Google's own label rendering, not a designed data surface.
The Places suggestion row still shows the raw powered by Google wordmark inside an otherwise fully custom navy/cream field, breaking editorial styling at the exact success moment.
The right roughly 55 percent of the first viewport at 1440 is a static, undifferentiated aerial doing no data work until a visitor types an address, on a page whose whole premise is data-first.

defects.section: Value my home CTA, rest state
defects.finding: The rest-state accent tile is roughly 50px wide with a single small dotted chevron at low contrast against navy, giving almost no visual cue that the control expands on interaction before a visitor discovers it.

tasteReview.verdict: demoMatch is true as returned. Rest vs ask-open shows the cream accent tile growing from about 50px to nearly the full compact pill with a dotted-chevron trail across the grown area, matching the beUI layout-size expand. House-stage street reframe and the sourced Sheet still hold. Remaining defects are craft and cartography, not the named expanding-arrow reject.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason. 2026-09-28 reseed (tip/sell-landing-rebuild, measured on a local production build of that branch): words 823 -> 538 and heroImageNatural 3780 -> 1296 are lowered on purpose. Matt's cuts removed the market-rows table, the long plan list (now behind a toggle) and the Dataset schema; the hero is now a pre-sized 640-1920w webp srcset instead of the 4200px original, which is what cut page weight from ~15.6 MB to ~4.5 MB.
